//: Drop-in at <project>/.omp/lsp.json to swap pyright for ty IN THIS PROJECT ONLY. Per omp://lsp-config.md:29-30, a cwd .omp/lsp.json outranks the agent directory's, so nothing generated is edited and no other project is affected. Both keys are required together: omp's ONE SERVER PER JOB rule means enabling ty without disabling pyright puts two type servers and two indexers on the same file. Verified: with this file, 'lsp status' reports ty (ready) and pyright never spawns, and diagnostics arrive tagged [ty].
